column7: Read value. Writes to this register use a packed on/off + mode format (see notes).

column15: 0 = Auto; 1 = Cooling; 2 = Dry (dehumidification); 3 = Fan; 4 = Heat; 11 = Auto cool; 12 = Auto dry; 13 = Auto fan; 14 = Auto heat

column7: Read value. Writes use a packed fan speed + louver format (see notes).

column15: 0 = Swing off; 1 = Swing on: upper and lower louver; 2 = Swing on: right and left louver; 3 = Swing on: upper/lower and right/left louver
